summary: Young renters say the rent is ridiculous, share it with roommates and name no one to blame.
realLife: Young adults across Northeast Ohio sounded practical and resigned about rent. They called it expensive and ridiculous but rarely named a person or policy responsible, and sharing with roommates was how they stayed independent. One student said she did not want to move back with her parents because she had been on her own. The only explanation came from a property manager who pointed to the post-pandemic rent spike, high interest rates and too few homes.
sources: https://ideastream.org/economy/2024-03-21/generation-z-adults-share-the-cost-to-afford-rent-in-ne-ohio (public radio story on young renters sharing rent)
